About.title: The {brandName} Story
About.storyP1: It all began with a belief: good furniture should last a lifetime. {brandName} carries that belief into today's homes with skill, patience and care.
About.storyP2: In our workshop, every piece is shaped one at a time, by hands that have known wood and fabric for years. No armchair, no table is identical to another — because handcraft aims for character, not perfect repetition.
About.storyP3: We bring classic craftsmanship together with the simplicity of modern living. The result: furniture that stands the test of time and feels at home in today's interiors.
About.craftText: No mass production, no molded pieces. Every order comes to life through weeks of work in the hands of our artisans.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At {brandName} we take the protection of your personal data seriously. This notice explains which data we process, why we process it and how long we keep it, in line with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law no. 6698 (KVKK).
Privacy.controllerText: The data controller is {legalName}. You can send any question or request regarding this notice to {email}.
Privacy.dataText: When you complete the contact or quote form on our site, we receive your name, e-mail address, phone number (if provided) and the content of your message. To prevent abuse of the form, your IP address is never stored in raw form — only as an irreversible hash.
Privacy.purposeText: Your data is processed solely to answer your enquiry, prepare a quote, handle the order process and prevent form abuse. We do not send marketing e-mails without your consent.
Privacy.legalBasisText: Processing is based on KVKK art. 5/2-c (directly related to the conclusion or performance of a contract) and art. 5/2-f (legitimate interests of the data controller).
Privacy.sharingText: Your personal data is never sold to third parties. Only our hosting, database and e-mail providers process the data on our behalf and on our instructions so the site can operate. Data may be shared with competent public authorities where legally required.
Privacy.retentionText: Data submitted through the form is kept for a maximum of 3 years after your enquiry is resolved, after which it is deleted or anonymised.
Privacy.cookiesText: Our site uses no advertising or tracking cookies. Only strictly necessary cookies are used, to remember your language preference and to keep the admin panel session signed in.
Privacy.rightsText: Under KVKK art. 11 you have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, to request information about it, to request its correction, deletion or destruction, and to object to processing. Send your requests to {email}; we respond within 30 days at the latest.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.intro: By visiting this site you are deemed to have accepted the terms below. If you do not accept them, please do not use the site.
Terms.scopeText: The {brandName} website is a product catalogue; no direct sales are made and no online payments are taken through it. Product enquiries are submitted via the contact form and each enquiry is assessed individually.
Terms.ipText: All images, designs, texts and brand elements on the site belong to {legalName}. They may not be copied, reproduced, used commercially or republished elsewhere without written permission.
Terms.productText: Because every piece is handcrafted, there may be slight variations in wood grain, colour tone and dimensions. This is not a defect but a natural result of handcraft. Images on the site are representative.
Terms.priceText: Prices shown on the site are for information only and do not constitute a binding offer of sale. The current price, material options and lead time are confirmed to you in a written quote.
Terms.liabilityText: We take care to keep the information on this site accurate and up to date; however we cannot be held liable for indirect damages arising from typographical errors or from the site being temporarily unavailable.
Terms.linksText: The site may contain third-party links such as our social media accounts and a map service. {brandName} is not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites.
Terms.changesText: These terms may be updated without prior notice. The current version is always published on this page.
Terms.lawText: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye. The courts and enforcement offices of {courtCity} have jurisdiction over any dispute.
Terms.contactText: For any questions you can reach us at {email}.
